snowboardingDaysParkReview2024.title: The 13 Best Park Snowboards [2024]
snowboardingDaysParkReview2024.evidence: The author says they tested park boards that season and includes CAPiTA Pathfinder Reverse Camber as a first-person pick, describing it as forgiving, pressable, poppy/responsive and fun in the park; notes a loose/squirrely feel at speed. The article does not disclose the exact tested production year, size, date, snow conditions or number of days for this board; use as contemporaneous directional evidence, not a controlled sample record. Its 8.9/10 is the reviewer's overall rating and is not converted to site dimensions.
snowboardingDaysParkReview2024.hostNote: Independent editorial review with affiliate links; not manufacturer-hosted.

snowboardingProfiles2025Sample.title: Capita Pathfinder Rev Snowboard Review
snowboardingProfiles2025Sample.seasonRelation: Next model year versus the seed's 2024 / 2023-24 Pathfinder Reverse; do not call it a same-season test.
snowboardingProfiles2025Sample.evidence: Discloses soft-packed groomers with fresh snow and shallow/moderate off-piste powder. Tester describes very easy turn initiation and quick edge-to-edge maneuverability, near-catch-free behavior, easy jib/butter and switch, but weak deep-carve/speed/chunder stability and limited jump confidence at high approach speeds. Review subratings include turns 4.5/5, jibbing 4.5/5, butters 4.5/5, jumps 3.5/5, speed 2.5/5, powder 2.5/5. These are qualitative directional evidence only and are not linearly mapped to site scores.
snowboardingProfiles2025Sample.limitations: Adjacent 2025 model-year 155 sample, one disclosed demo date; not the exact 2024 representative 151 sample.

representativeSize.selectionRule: Median of standard-width sizes 145/147/149/151/153/155/157; wide variants excluded.
representativeSize.specSource: Backcountry 2024 size table, cross-checked against Snowleader 2024 full geometry rows and adjacent size/dimension data.

seedMappingNotes: Calendar model year 2024 is listed by Snowleader as 2023/24 season. The official CAPiTA historical archive/catalog matching this exact season was not located; model identity and specifications are supported by retailers.

Retain the legacy Horrorscope slug for URL/database compatibility, but product display/model should be Pathfinder Reverse 2024. The supposed Horrorscope-to-Pathfinder relationship is described by secondary retailer/industry copy, not asserted as an official name-change statement.

The 151 standard-size geometry is the median of the seven standard lengths. Do not choose 153 just because some retailers only list/supply it as their reference/default size. Backcountry marks stance/setback as centered, mapped as stanceSetback 0.
Snowleader reports board weight 3000 g at reference size 155; it is not mapped to the representative size 151. No size-151 board weight verified.

The CNY 3096 seed figure is a rounded conversion of USD 429.95 using a legacy project reference rate of 7.2; it is not a local Chinese-market listing and is unsuitable as current local price evidence. Preserve only as a labeled estimate pending price schema/provenance improvement.

Internal damping/pop sliders are editorial 1-10 estimates, not CAPiTA specifications or direct translations of review scales. Pop is set to 7 based on qualitative reports of quick ollies and solid park pop; damping remains a provisional 5 because tests note reduced stability in rough snow but provide no damping-specific measurement.

Score calibration: response changed 5.9→7.2 and park 8.1→8.5 based on contemporaneous 2024 park-review descriptions and directional 2025 sample observations of easy/quick turning, jib/butter and switch. No external numerical score was converted. Stability 5.8, float 5.5 and forgiveness 9 are retained; value 8.1 is especially provisional because the CNY price is only a legacy USD conversion, not a verified local price.
Existing seed image is hosted by Boyne Country Sports; ownership/reuse permission is unverified.

pricing.availabilityAtCapture: Both retailer listings displayed sold-out/unavailable status.
pricing.conversion: USD 429.95 × 7.2 = CNY 3095.64, rounded to 3096; legacy project reference rate, not spot FX or an observed China retail price.
pricing.note: Do not interpret either the old USD list price or stale retailer markdown as the current local price or MSRP without official/catalog evidence and matching price dates.

scoringEvidence.decision: Raise response and park modestly from specific ease-of-turning, quick edge transition, press/jib/butter/switch observations. Keep stability low given speed/chunder/jump-approach limits. Keep float low and uncertain because powder exposure was shallow/moderate and both reviews suggest deep-powder limits. Forgiveness remains high and directionally supported. Do not change value until a local price source exists.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low-to-moderate overall: the contemporaneous 2024 review lacks per-board test metadata, and the detailed 155 cm test is 2025 model year, one year newer than this seed.
